answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Every claim climbs the nadir of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ferrous re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. By the river of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
